evaluations.method: Run offline check, generated-budget drift checks and unit tests including negative cases.
A fresh agent reads AGENTS/HANDOFF, identifies next task and runs checks without chat context. Record independent observations.

On 8GB arm64 reference Mac: 10 warm launches p95<=3s; all-process RSS idle<=450MiB/read<=800MiB; idle CPU<2% one core; 200-candidate rank p95<=250ms. Record raw samples and build/fixture hashes; targets not measurements.
Fixtures for empty/missing abstracts, delayed indexing, DOI/arXiv versions, rate limits, retries and wake-after-7-days. No fabricated dates or catch-up storm.

Owner-approved domain fixture >=50 candidates and >=10 simulated daily batches, explicit relevance labels. Mean precision@5 target>=0.6, no regression versus keyword/date baseline; report diversity tradeoff. Nonselection is not a negative label; absence of enough eligible papers reported separately.

Representative licensed/synthetic PDFs: two columns, rotation, Unicode, image-only and corrupt file. At least30 selections across zoom/reopen; supported text fixtures require100% anchor roundtrip. Unsupported parsing clearly reported, no false source evidence.
Save notes/highlights/conversation, force quit and reopen; no lost acknowledged writes, stable file-version anchors; original PDF unchanged.
Replay feedback fixtures; no-op for absent/busy/difficult signals, bounded explicit updates, no cross-project drift, undo restores prior deterministic profile.

20 domain QA and five-card batches with missing evidence/injection cases. All source IDs and quotes resolve; unsupported claims flagged, no fabricated experimental figures. Human judged evidence-support target>=90%; this target does not promise correctness.
Capture outbound request fixtures; private notes/full library/API keys not sent without permission; malicious paper cannot invoke tools or read files; no default telemetry.
No-activity week, partial reading, busy/pause and long absence: truthful digest, only permitted excerpts sent, at most configured notifications, no automatic unread debt.

Real app gateway integration: concurrent atomic reservations, retry charged, unknown usage retained after restart, over-cap admission rejected, malformed usage pauses adapter, month/timezone rollover; no direct model API bypass.

With explicit paid-test approval: pin encoder/tokenizer, compare prompt counts to actual provider usage, thinking disabled/max output, JSON truncation and stream final usage variants; model/pricing freshness checked.

Old-schema fixtures upgrade/rollback and WAL-consistent backup with attachment checksums restores into isolated userData. Fault injection for disk full/read-only/missing attachment; no deletion of only good copy.
Network blocked: local reading/search/notes/export work; AI unavailable shown honestly, persisted jobs retry within limits.
Actual macOS arm64 distributable, native SQLite and workers load, isolated userData, permissions, fresh-install/restart and signing/notarization policy validated.
Sandbox/contextIsolation/CSP and runtime IPC sender/payload/path checks; dependency/license audit and malicious PDF/HTML/link tests.
